This example uses a larger gap of 4rem between columns for more breathing room.
custom-gap.rightContent:
Spacing Control

The gap property can be customized to match your design needs.

Common values: 1rem (16px), 2rem (32px), 3rem (48px), 4rem (64px).

Primary Content

In this layout, the left column is wider (2fr) and contains the main content.

This is useful when the primary information should be on the left with supplementary content on the right.
